policies: We suggest you prepare for the weather, if the sun is out load up on sunblock and bring some water.
Bad Weather We will sail in a light drizzle but anything more and we'll cancel the trip.
Regardless of the weather where you are, don't assume the trip is cancelled, often-times we can use the radar to avoid the rain and will still sail.
The captain reserves the right to cancel any trip for any reason.
If we cancel a trip you will be issued a refund.
Dress for the weather, we don't get the kids wet so bathing suits aren't required.

faq.q: hat should the kids wear and what do we need to bring?
faq.a: Dress appropriate for the weather. We don't get the children wet so bathing suits aren't needed. Sunblock and a camera are a must! We have ice cold water for only $1 at the dock.

faq.q: s it rough, or more importantly, will we get seasick?
faq.a: Our adventure takes place in the calm waters of the Calibogue Sound. We always look for the calmest water so seasickness is extraordinarily rare!

faq.q: an we take pictures and video?
faq.a: Absolutely! We encourage it and even give you a couple of great photo-ops during the trip. If possible we would love it if you post to our Facebook page or Tripadvisor.
